title: Frozen exact execution intent
summary: After successful preflight, the broker freezes an exact, deterministic intent and hashes its canonical representation.
invariants: Exact test commands, writable scopes, network policy and resource ceilings are bound.
The intent includes requester, run ID, nonce and authorization expiry.
Material drift after signing produces INTENT_STALE.

provenance.claim: Canonical intent/material hashing and drift detection.
